condition: Pre-operative assessment — end-stage renal failure on haemodialysis with hyperkalaemia
summary: 58-year-old woman on haemodialysis (Mon/Wed/Fri) listed for laparoscopic cholecystectomy; pre-operative potassium 6.2 mmol/L on a non-dialysis day.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Pre-operative assessment for planned gallbladder operation
inputs.hpi: Symptomatic gallstones, listed for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. End-stage renal failure (hypertensive nephropathy) on haemodialysis Monday/Wednesday/Friday via a left radiocephalic fistula. Passes about 200 mL urine a day. Pre-assessment bloods taken on Sunday. Walks a mile on the flat.

exam.general: Well. HR 76, BP 156/88, RR 16, SpO2 97% on air, T 36.5°C. Left forearm AV fistula with good thrill.

imaging.name: USS abdomen
imaging.result: Multiple mobile gallstones, gallbladder wall 2 mm, no pericholecystic fluid. CBD 4 mm. Liver normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Pre-operative assessment — symptomatic gallstones; ESRF on haemodialysis, K⁺ 6.2
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic cholelithiasis. End-stage renal failure on HD (Mon/Wed/Fri). Potassium 6.2 mmol/L on a non-dialysis day. ASA III.

mustInclude.note: Potassium 6.2 mmol/L must be corrected (dialysis) before anaesthesia.
Dialysis patients: dialysis is the definitive treatment of hyperkalaemia; schedule dialysis before surgery.
mustInclude.proposedFix: In the hyperkalaemia and pre-op prompts, when the PMH contains dialysis/ESRF: 'arrange dialysis before surgery (usually the day before) and recheck K⁺'.

mustExclude.note: NICE NG89: in renal failure use LMWH or UFH with dose adjustment for renal function.
mustExclude.knownGapNote: The lap chole template orders 'LMWH (Enoxaparin 40mg SC) night before + day of surgery' with no renal qualification for a dialysis patient.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Operative templates: 'LMWH dose-adjusted for renal function (UFH if eGFR <30 or dialysis per local protocol)' when creatinine/eGFR or dialysis is recorded.

mustExclude.note: NSAIDs harm residual renal function in dialysis patients. The lap chole template qualifies ibuprofen "(if eGFR normal)", which counts as qualified.
Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: UK Kidney Association — clinical practice guideline: treatment of acute hyperkalaemia in adults
guideline.section: Mild 5.5–5.9, moderate 6.0–6.4, severe ≥6.5 mmol/L; insulin-glucose for K⁺ ≥6.0 mmol/L; ECG; treat the cause; dialysis for refractory hyperkalaemia or in dialysis patients
guideline.citation: UK Kidney Association. Treatment of acute hyperkalaemia in adults. 2020 (updated 2023).

guideline.name: Revised Cardiac Risk Index (Lee)
guideline.section: High-risk surgery (intraperitoneal, intrathoracic, suprainguinal vascular), ischaemic heart disease, heart failure, cerebrovascular disease, insulin-treated diabetes, creatinine >2 mg/dL (177 µmol/L)
guideline.citation: Lee TH, Marcantonio ER, Mangione CM, et al. Circulation. 1999;100:1043–9.

guideline.name: NICE NG89 — Venous thromboembolism in over 16s: reducing the risk of hospital-acquired DVT or PE
guideline.section: Assess VTE and bleeding risk; abdominal surgery with VTE risk above bleeding risk: pharmacological prophylaxis (LMWH) for at least 7 days; extended to 28 days after major cancer surgery in the abdomen/pelvis; mechanical prophylaxis (anti-embolism stockings or IPC) when pharmacological prophylaxis is contraindicated by bleeding risk; reassess within 24 h and when the clinical situation changes
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. VTE in over 16s (NG89). London: NICE; 2018 (updated 2019).

guideline.name: NICE NG203 — Chronic kidney disease: assessment and management
guideline.section: Avoid long-term NSAIDs in CKD; adjust drug doses for renal function
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Chronic kidney disease (NG203). London: NICE; 2021.

rationale: Permutation: CKD 5 on dialysis. Tests recognition of pre-operative hyperkalaemia, deferral until corrected, dialysis timing and renal-safe VTE prophylaxis and analgesia.
